page.title: Work · Samantha Paras
page.meta: Projects by Samantha Paras: QuestKeeper, a full-stack D&D companion; Can You Spot It, a team-built AI trivia game; a software engineering externship with Nugget; and local SEO and booking fixes for Reckoning Tattoo.
intro.h1: Things I've built, and why they exist
intro.text: Each project starts with the problem or idea behind it. QuestKeeper's case study follows what I tried, what broke and what changed.
card.nugget.summary: Help parents find family-friendly restaurants through reviews grounded in real family context. I built community groups and a guided four-step review form.
card.nearmora.name: nearmora
card.nearmora.summary: A local-first Mac app for finding your favorite photos, choosing between similar shots and turning them into collages and carousels. It never uploads, moves or edits your originals.
card.nearmora.stack: Stack: Electron · React 19 · TypeScript · SQLite · Vitest · Playwright
card.nearmora.evidence: Status: Prototype. Test builds only, not signed yet
card.voxgig.name: Voxgig developer tools
card.voxgig.origin: Voxgig wanted an honest opinion of their developer tools.
card.voxgig.summary: I generated a Resend SDK in TypeScript, Python and Go with their SDK generator, tried Aontu, and used Jostraca on a React component generator. Then I told them what worked, what didn't and why.
card.voxgig.stack: Tools: Voxgig SDK generator · Jostraca · Aontu · TypeScript · Python
card.voxgig.evidence: Status: Feedback delivered; Jostraca review published on dev.to
